name: context-left
description: Shows the context window left in the prompt footer, coloured green, orange or red. Optionally compacts at a set percentage, with Jev clearing old tool output first

compactEnabled.title: Compact automatically
compactEnabled.description: Start a compaction when a turn ends at or above the threshold below, and let Jev clear old tool output first. Off: the mod only shows the footer label

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at (% used)
compactAtPercent.description: Share of the context window used at which a turn's end starts a compaction

compactModel.title: Summary model
compactModel.description: Model that writes the summary. If its call fails, the engine writes the summary instead

compactEffort.title: Summary effort
compactEffort.description: Reasoning effort of the summary call

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's API. With none set, Jev clears nothing and the summary is still written

keepRecentToolResults.title: Recent tool results kept
keepRecentToolResults.description: How many of the newest tool results Jev is never asked about

dropConfidence.title: Confidence to clear
dropConfidence.description: How sure Jev must be that a tool output is not needed again before it is cleared. A higher number clears less

jevTimeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for each Jev attempt, in milliseconds. Each request gets three attempts

resetToDefaults.title: Reset to defaults
resetToDefaults.description: On: ignore every value above except the API key and Compact automatically, and use the defaults. Off: use your values
